overview:
**Extreme fire danger continues today, driven by critically dry fuels (ERC 98%, BI 93%) and afternoon humidity near 15%.**
- Danger trend: eases from Extreme today/Monday to Very High midweek, then High by Thursday as rain chances rise.
- Weather driver: light NE winds around 9 mph, patchy smoke, and only a slight chance of afternoon storms; no Red Flag Warning is currently posted.
- Watchout status: 4 of 7 local thresholds exceeded (ERC, BI, min RH, max RH) — expect erratic, wind-driven fire behavior.
- Restrictions: Stage 1 fire restrictions remain in effect on BLM/USFS lands across Gunnison, Delta, Mesa, Montrose, Ouray, Hinsdale, Saguache and San Juan counties; San Miguel County is under Stage 2.
- Nearby incidents: Gold Mountain Fire near Ouray is 39,532 acres and 90% contained; Elk Fire on the Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre & Gunnison National Forest is 5,763 acres and 39% contained, with incident command transferring today.
